title: ServiceStatus
description: TV service status: the JSON carried as a string in the `status` value of the reply to {request: "status"} (see status-reply.schema.json).

version.description: TV package version (the project version, e.g. `1.1.0`); null if the service could not read it (app_get_version).

configWarnings.description: Problems found in the output settings in effect: res/ambilight.json (the affected outputs are disabled), or saved settings that could not be used. Empty after a successful `set-outputs`.

OutputsSource.title: OutputsSource
OutputsSource.description: `package`: res/ambilight.json, bundled into the TV package. `saved`: set with the `set-outputs` command and saved on the TV; replaces res/ambilight.json until the app's data is cleared.

OutputsStatus.title: OutputsStatus
OutputsStatus.description: The output settings in effect (what `set-outputs` sets), for showing and editing them. An invalid HyperHDR section in res/ambilight.json shows here as `enabled: false`.

HyperHdrOutputSettingsInEffect.title: HyperHdrOutputSettingsInEffect
HyperHdrOutputSettingsInEffect.description: HyperHdrOutputSettings with every value filled in.

CaptureState.title: CaptureState
CaptureState.description: `waiting`: capture not started yet. `starting`: initialising. `running`: frames are captured. `paused`: stopped by the `pause` command until `resume`. `failed`: could not start; retried (see `retryInMs`).

CaptureFailure.title: CaptureFailure
CaptureFailure.description: Why capture failed. `library` / `symbols`: the TV does not expose the capture API. `hardware`: the API is there but reported an unusable state.

HwCondition.title: HwCondition
HwCondition.description: What the hardware reported (`ppi_ve_get_rgb_measure_condition`) and the delay in use.

ret.description: Return code of the condition query (0 = OK).

hwDelayMs.description: Delay the hardware asks for between setting a position and reading it.

CaptureStatus.title: CaptureStatus
CaptureStatus.description: Screen capture state. The frame fields (`frameMs` … `rgb`) are present once a frame was captured since the last (re)start.

failure.description: Why the last start failed; null if it didn't.

error.description: Error message of the last failure.

failedAttempts.description: Failed starts since the service started.

retryInMs.description: Time until the next start attempt; only while `failed`.

reads.description: Samples read in the last frame.

badReads.description: How many of them returned an error (they keep the previous color).

lastBadRet.description: Error code of the last failed read.

h.description: Samples per horizontal edge (top, bottom) in the last frame.

v.description: Samples per vertical edge (left, right) in the last frame.

rgb.description: Last frame's samples as uppercase hex, 2 × (h + v) × 3 bytes in frame order: top L→R, right T→B, bottom R→L, left B→T.

hosts.description: Discovered hosts frames are sent to (ESP32s and tools/server.py).

framesSent.description: Frames handed to the network. UDP has no replies: sent, not necessarily received.

lastError.description: Message of the last failed send.

Esp32OutputStatus.title: Esp32OutputStatus
Esp32OutputStatus.description: UDP output to the discovered controllers.

replies.description: Replies received from HyperHDR on this connection.

lastError.description: Message of the last connection error.
